modules.name: health_careplan
modules.title: Care Plans & Goals
modules.purpose: The missing clinical spine: structured care plans with goals, interventions, review cycles, and outcome measures; links every FSO visit and task back to a plan goal; Blockly pathway rules auto-adjust plans from assessment scores. Foundation for outcome-linked pricing and the health twin.

modules.name: health_vitals
modules.title: Structured Vitals & Observations
modules.purpose: Replaces free-text vitals with typed, unit-validated observation records (BP, HR, SpO2, glucose, weight, pain) with per-client reference ranges, trend charts, and abnormal-value escalation. LOINC-coded from day one so the FHIR gateway maps cleanly to Observation resources.

modules.name: health_emar
modules.title: Medication Management & eMAR
modules.purpose: Client medication list, schedules, administration records with witness/refusal/PRN flows, and reconciliation at intake — wired to the existing RxNorm/OpenFDA interaction checker in health.medication.safety. Offline administration recording in the nurse PWA.

modules.name: health_forms
modules.title: Clinical Forms & Assessment Engine
modules.purpose: A structured forms builder (Barthel, MMSE, PHQ-9, custom intake) with versioning, scoring formulas, conditional sections, and offline PWA rendering — generalizing the Morse falls pattern into a reusable engine whose scores feed care plans and the early-warning model.

modules.name: health_incident
modules.title: Incident & Event Management
modules.purpose: Falls, medication errors, injuries, complaints and near-misses with severity taxonomy, immediate-notification rules, investigation workflow, CAPA tracking, and regulator-ready registers (NDIS reportable incidents format for Australia). One-tap incident capture from the PWA mid-visit.

modules.name: health_consent
modules.title: Consent & Privacy Management
modules.purpose: Versioned consent artifacts (service, data-sharing, photography, telehealth) with e-signature capture on the nurse's device, per-purpose data-sharing scopes enforced via access_roles, expiry/renewal tracking, and Decree 13/PDPA/GDPR-grade audit trails.

modules.name: health_portal_family
modules.title: Family & Client Portal
modules.purpose: Role-scoped portal driven by the health.client.relation kinship graph: visit calendar and summaries, care-moment feed, quote approval, payments, task board for family members, and the honest-trajectory view. Zalo Mini App and web front ends share one API.

modules.name: health_messaging
modules.title: Secure Messaging & Reminders
modules.purpose: In-app secure threads between care team and family (attachment-safe, consent-aware), plus an omnichannel reminder orchestrator (ZNS-first, SMS fallback, push) with the behavioural nudge engine's send-time and tone optimization.

modules.name: health_telehealth
modules.title: Telehealth & Micro-Consults
modules.purpose: WebRTC video consultations with waiting room, in-visit micro-consult requests from nurse to on-call doctor (async photo/voice or live), consult notes flowing into the clinical record, and billing through existing quote/invoice rails.

modules.name: health_routes
modules.title: Route Optimization & Geo Intelligence
modules.purpose: Daily multi-stop route optimization per nurse (travel-time matrices tuned for motorbike traffic in HCMC/Hanoi), geofenced auto check-in/out suggestions, live ETA sharing to families via ZNS, and travel-cost analytics feeding the assignment engine's optimization crons.

modules.name: health_telemonitoring
modules.title: Remote Monitoring & Device Hub
modules.purpose: Device registry and ingestion pipeline for BLE/LoRa home sensors and consumer wearables (store-and-forward gateway for rural connectivity), signal normalization into biz_bi silver tables, threshold/trend alerting, and the wearable-triggered dispatch hook into the booking engine.

modules.name: health_fhir_gateway
modules.title: FHIR R4 Gateway & Country Adapters
modules.purpose: Canonical FHIR R4 facade (Patient, Encounter, ServiceRequest, Observation, CarePlan, Coverage) over existing models with SNOMED-CT/ICD-10/LOINC terminology service, OAuth2/SMART scopes, and pluggable country adapters: VN MOH EMR circulars/LGSP, Singapore NEHR, Australia NDIS/My Health Record.

modules.name: health_api_gateway
modules.title: Enterprise API Platform
modules.purpose: Versioned OpenAPI surface over the whole platform (beyond the PWA-only REST): API keys, per-partner rate limits, webhook subscriptions, scoped tokens, and full request audit — the substrate for the care-ecosystem exchange, corporate payer integrations, and MISA/insurer connections.

modules.name: health_claims
modules.title: Claims & Funder Billing
modules.purpose: Claim lifecycle management for non-private payers: corporate contracts, Vietnamese social insurance readiness, NDIS bulk payment requests and price-guide validation, Singapore MediSave/CHAS formats — with rejection handling, remittance reconciliation against health_invoicing AR, and funder-specific document packs.

modules.name: health_twin
modules.title: Digital Twin & Predictive Engine
modules.purpose: The client health twin and operations twin: trajectory modeling from vitals/notes/telemonitoring, deterioration early-warning worklists (cloud LLM or on-prem Ollama), what-if simulation for care intensity and staffing scenarios, and the benchmarking-network export layer.
modules.depends_on: health_vitals, health_careplan, health_telemonitoring, biz_bi, hr_development_ai (provider factory)
